description: Amends Aspen Ridge plan, removing eastern land and buffer.
Adds multi-unit and residential care home sites; rezones FUD.
Neighborhood area decreases; population slightly increases.

chips.text: Superintendent Martin confirmed schools can accommodate population increase.
Aspen Ridge neighborhood residents affected by plan changes.
Two individuals provided feedback, one raising traffic and parking concerns.
Linear park construction, Link Later, slated to start this year.

description: Rezones 702 and 706 Victoria Avenue for high-density.
Permits a six-story, 33-37 unit condominium building.
Zoning agreement controls height and specific design features.

chips.text: Administration clarified short-term rentals require inclusion in zoning agreement.
Residents seeking bespoke, lock-and-leave condominium housing.
Public raised concerns about traffic, lane use, and construction impacts.
Project includes a green roof and protects mature boulevard trees.

speakers.name: James Peirce
speakers.summary: Registered to speak on: 702 and 706 Victoria Ave
said: Proposed 6-story building is appropriate for the prominent site.
Design includes active frontage, green roof, and ample parking.
Addresses market need for bespoke, lock-and-leave condominium lifestyle.

description: Permits two garden/garage suites per two-unit dwelling, up to four units.
Removes two-story height limits for garden/garage suites with rear lanes.
Allows six units on corner lots in Transit Development Area as discretionary.

chips.text: Administration explained six units as discretionary allows council review of changing development.
Developers and residents near corner lots in Transit Development Area are affected.
Public comments raised concerns about traffic, parking, and servicing impacts.

description: City's Planning Commission has $7,000 for 2026 conferences.

chips.text: New Planning Commission members are encouraged to attend.
